verdict.rationale: Lovable's built-in Cloud backend includes edge functions alongside the database, auth and storage, and the builder generates integrations from chat prompts. The docs evidence prebuilt connectors (ClickHouse, the AI connector) and custom MCP connectors for third-party APIs. missing for 10: explicit documentation of payment (e.g., Stripe) and transactional email integrations, detail on authoring or deploying server-side functions, independent hands-on corroboration.
